_preregistered: Pre-registered 2026-11-09, BEFORE any NQ number under this protocol exists: the out-of-domain test of the planner. Identical to msmarco_1m_v3.json in every protocol field (metric Recall@10, K=10, eps 0.01, tau 0.005, eval_frac 0.5, first-service arrivals, traffic grid 4/16/64/256 with 64 primary, strategies, orders, seed 0) except: the corpus is the BEIR NQ 100k subset (subnq/, 1,000 judged test queries, so 500 replayed for evaluation); window depths are absolute (kprime 10..1000) because a fraction of 1e5 documents would round every shallow rung to K; there is no deeply judged secondary set. The sibling files nq_100k_v3_k{25,100,200,500,1000}.json differ ONLY in 'window'. Procedure: measure static inputs (coverage, sweeps, measure-only runs), run plan.py, COMMIT planner_nq/plan.csv, then replay each pair at the depth the committed plan names (S0/S1 plans at the default 50) and score with check_planner.py. Nothing is re-planned after a replay.
